data.description: Queue Point Dubai: Affordable Modern Living with Easy City Access.

data.answer: Living in Queue Point Dubai offers residents a serene environment surrounded by lush greenery and landscaped gardens. The community is equipped with modern facilities, including swimming pools, state-of-the-art gyms, and children’s play areas. With parks, retail outlets, and entertainment venues nearby, Queue Point Liwan Dubai delivers the perfect blend of urban convenience and suburban tranquility.

Queue Point Liwan features contemporary apartments with spacious layouts and premium finishes. Available in one, two, and three-bedroom configurations, some units also offer private balconies or terraces, catering to diverse lifestyle needs.

Renting a Property in Queue Point

1-bedroom apartments, ranging from 650 to 800 sq. ft., are ideal for singles or couples, offering a spacious living area, a modern kitchen, and a comfortable bedroom. Rental prices for these units range between AED 45,000 and AED 66,000 annually. 2-bedroom apartments span 1,000 to 1,200 sq. ft. and include two bedrooms, multiple bathrooms, and additional spaces such as balconies or terraces, with rental prices ranging between AED 65,000 and AED 125,000. 

3-bedroom apartments, starting at 1,600 sq. ft., have generous living and dining spaces. These expansive units have rental prices starting from AED 95,000 per year. Those seeking more variety can explore rental apartments in Liwan.

Buying a Property in Queue Point

Queue Point Dubai offers excellent opportunities to own modern homes in a desirable location. 1-bedroom apartments, priced between AED 430,000 and AED 1,050,000, provide a great entry point into the property market. 2-bedroom apartments, with prices ranging from AED 720,000 to AED 1,700,000, offer additional space and flexibility for growing families. 

For those looking for luxury, the 3-bedroom apartments are available from AED 1,100,000 to AED 1,430,000. Buyers can also explore various apartments for sale in Liwan, offering a range of prices and configurations to suit different needs.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Queue Point Dubai?

data.answer:
Residents of Queue Point Liwan benefit from a comfortable lifestyle with access to modern amenities, including swimming pools, fitness centers, and landscaped gardens. The location offers proximity to public transportation, shopping malls, and top schools. Known for its peaceful and family-friendly atmosphere, Queue Point is an ideal community for those seeking a high-quality lifestyle in Dubai.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Queue Point

Queue Point Dubai’s location ensures excellent connectivity with major road networks. Dubai - Al Ain Road (E66) offers direct access to Dubai Creek Harbour, while Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) provides easy connectivity to other parts of the city. Both highways are about a 5-minute drive away. Moreover, public transportation is convenient, with frequent buses running on routes 66 and 67, stopping directly within the community.

Supermarkets near Queue Point

For grocery shopping, residents of Liwan Queue Point Dubai have several supermarkets nearby, including New W Mart Supermarket Liwan, Top Grocer Supermarket, and Fresco Mart, all within easy reach.

Shopping Malls in Queue Point

Q1 Mall, located within Queue Point Liwan, offers a variety of retail stores, from fashion boutiques to electronics shops, as well as supermarkets and restaurants. With a spacious layout and ample parking, this popular shopping destination serves the needs of both residents and visitors.

Schools and Nurseries near Queue Point Area

British Orchard Nursery, located just two minutes from Queue Point, offers the British Early Years Foundation Stage curriculum for children aged 1 to 3, focusing on language development, literacy, numeracy, and social skills. The Indian International School, a 10-minute drive from Queue Point, follows the CBSE curriculum, emphasizing academic excellence, cultural diversity, and holistic development from pre-primary to secondary levels.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Queue Point Location

There are several mosques near Queue Point, such as Masjid Al Noor, which is within walking distance and offers regular prayers and community events. Other nearby mosques include Masjid Al Salaam and Masjid Al Tawheed, both within a 10-minute drive. 

For the Hindu community, the Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, located approximately 20 minutes away, is known for its beautiful architecture and vibrant festivals. 

St. Mary’s Church, about 15 minutes away by car, serves the Christian community with regular services, Sunday school, and outreach programs. Other nearby churches include St. Andrew’s Church and St. Joseph’s Church.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Queue Point Area

Al Noor Medical Center, within walking distance, offers general consultations, basic diagnostics, and minor treatments. For specialized care, residents can access Al Salam Medical Center or Al Tawheed Clinic, both within a 10-minute drive. 

For more serious medical needs or emergencies, Al Zahra Hospital, located 20 minutes away, provides a wide range of services, including emergency care, surgery, pediatrics, and maternity care.

Queue Point Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Queue Point Dubai is ideally located within Dubai Land, surrounded by prominent neighborhoods. To the north lies Dubai Silicon Oasis, a hub for tech companies and research centers, while Falcon City of Wonders in Dubailand offers a unique blend of residential and commercial properties. To the south, Nad Al Sheba is known for equestrian facilities and luxurious villas. Queue Point residents enjoy convenient access to several popular destinations within a 20-minute drive, such as Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and Jumeirah Beach.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Queue Point Area

data.answer:
Queue Point offers a variety of recreational activities for residents and visitors. The landscaped parks and green spaces are perfect for leisurely walks and picnics. The community also includes swimming pools, fitness centers, and children’s play areas. For shopping, residents can explore retail outlets and convenience stores located within the development.

Queue Point Restaurants

There are several dining options near Queue Point Liwan, offering a variety of cuisines. The Cheesecake Factory provides a classic American dining experience, while Al Tashahi serves authentic Lebanese dishes. For nightlife, residents can visit Mr. Toad’s Pub & Kitchen or Mogao Restaurant & Bar, both within a 10-minute drive.

Beaches near Queue Point

Jumeirah Beach, located about 30 minutes away, offers a stunning stretch of coastline with activities such as jet skiing, kayaking, and beachside dining. The area also features various shops, cafes, and restaurants, making it a perfect destination for a day by the sea.

Hotels near Queue Point Area

Premier Inn in Dubai Silicon Oasis, just 8 minutes away, offers a comfortable and convenient stay with its modern rooms and friendly service. It's a great option for budget-conscious travelers. Radisson RED DSO, 10 minutes away, provides a stylish and vibrant experience with its trendy design and rooftop pool. It's perfect for those seeking a more upscale and trendy atmosphere.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

The area surrounding Queue Point Liwan offers a variety of options for outdoor activities, fitness, and beauty treatments. Residents and visitors can enjoy a range of recreational pursuits.

Queue Point Attractions and Landmarks

Silicon Central Mall, about 8 minutes away, offers a variety of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment venues. 

IMG Worlds of Adventure, located nearby, provides a thrilling experience with rides and attractions themed around the Marvel Universe and Cartoon Network. 

Global Village Dubai, just 13 minutes away, celebrates cultures from around the world with pavilions, entertainment, and international cuisine.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms and Salons

Queue Point Liwan offers a variety of outdoor activities for residents, including parks, swimming pools, and recreational areas. Fitness options are also readily available within the complex, while nearby salons cater to the beauty needs of both men and women.

Queue Point Liwan offers a comfortable and convenient living experience. Residents can enjoy a range of amenities within the complex, including parks, swimming pools, and recreational areas. The complex provides a serene environment, perfect for those seeking a peaceful lifestyle.

What type of properties are available in Queue Point?

Queue Point offers modern apartments in various sizes, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom units.

What are the amenities and facilities available in Queue Point?

Residents can enjoy swimming pools, gyms, landscaped gardens, and children’s play areas, with easy access to parks, shopping malls, and entertainment venues.

What is the transportation situation in Queue Point?

Queue Point offers excellent connectivity via Al Ain Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, with frequent public buses running on routes 66 and 67.

What are some nearby shopping and dining options?

Q1 Mall and several supermarkets are located within the community, while nearby restaurants offer a variety of cuisines.

What are some nearby attractions and landmarks?

Popular attractions such as IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village, Dubai Mall, and Jumeirah Beach are all within a short drive from Queue Point.

Is Queue Point Dubai a good investment?

Yes, Queue Point Dubai offers solid investment potential, with competitive property prices, attractive rental yields, and long-term appreciation. Its strategic location, modern amenities, and family-friendly environment make it a wise choice for investors seeking sustainable returns.

data.content:
Queue Point, a distinguished residential development by Al Mazaya Holding, offers a luxurious and modern lifestyle in Dubai’s Liwan community. Featuring a variety of property options, including one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, Queue Point Dubai provides residents with an exceptional living environment. 

With amenities designed to enhance everyday life—such as swimming pools, gyms, parks, and recreational areas—Queue Point combines comfort with convenience. Its strategic location in Liwan ensures seamless access to major transportation networks, shopping destinations, and entertainment venues. 

Completed in 2007, the development remains a top choice for those seeking a sophisticated lifestyle in Dubai.
